verdict_reason: Removing the local endpoint copy is right, but binding the address-book scenario to the whole INS page catalogue leaves its request list with two owners.

todos.issue: Two homes for the address-book session's request list: SCENARIOS['ins-address-book'].endpoints is now INS_PAGES (endpoints.js:11, the catalogue of every INS page), while src/lib/address-book.js:18 ADDRESS_BOOK_SESSION_ENDPOINTS separately names each request the session makes after sign-in and the dashboard. The scenario's per-endpoint thresholds and report keys (thresholds.js scenarioThresholds) follow INS_PAGES, so an INS page added to the catalogue that the address-book session never requests gains a threshold on this scenario, and a request added to ADDRESS_BOOK_SESSION_ENDPOINTS only gets one if INS_PAGES is edited too.
todos.fix: Must: the address-book scenario's endpoint list is derived from the one list that names the requests an address-book session makes, so adding an INS page elsewhere cannot change it. One way: endpoints: ['sign-in', 'ins-dashboard', ...new Set(Object.values(ADDRESS_BOOK_SESSION_ENDPOINTS))], keeping INS_PAGES for the catalogue alone.
